notes.title: Pokémon adventure — Dossier fields & trainer challenges
notes.text: Original and Aperture share a detailed square Dossier interface. Desktop battles use a full-width 16:9 field above the command station; mobile keeps its 16:9 field and touch commands. All 20 fields separate animated backgrounds and complete standing bases. Compact HP plates keep Pokémon visible. Story-backed NPC trainer challenges require player acceptance and support teams of one to six with opponent party balls. Captures hide HP only and lock visible commands until motion ends.
